answer_1.quote: we introduce the novel generation task of faithfully reflecting updated information in text (FRUIT), where the goal is to incorporate new information into an existing piece of text.
tasks: Other:Faithfully Reflecting Updated Information in Text (FRUIT)
answer_1.outputs: updated articles that reflect new information while maintaining consistency with original text and evidence

answer_2.quote: we propose to evaluate FRUIT systems using an alternative metric, UpdateROUGE, that only considers updated sentences instead full texts.

answer_4.quote: To address the issue of unsupported claims during evaluation, we hired a team of 9 annotators to produce a "gold" evaluation subset of our test dataset.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were shown the source article, evidence, and a marked up copy of the target article. They were asked to highlight unsupported claims and incorrect reference labels, then remove unsupported text and minimally update the article to preserve fluency.
